Q1. Which exact area should be improved?
Choices:
A. Clarify / plan / approval flow in this repo
B. Implement / review_autofix / PR creation flow in this repo
C. Orchestrate / validate / issue↔PR sync / update-workflows in this repo
D. A consumer repo or wrapper using these workflows — name the repo and the wrapper/workflow
E. Another exact workflow, script, or file — name it (RECOMMENDED)
Q2. What concrete change should happen?
Choices:
A. Describe the current behavior and the desired behavior in 1-3 sentences (RECOMMENDED)
B. Name the exact wrong output, missing behavior, duplicate action, or failure you want fixed (RECOMMENDED)
C. This is mainly a docs / logs / alerts improvement rather than a behavior change
D. I cannot yet describe a specific before/after change
Q3. What specific example can we use to anchor the work?
Choices:
A. A workflow run ID, log snippet, or error message (RECOMMENDED)
B. An issue/PR number, comment, or screenshot showing the problem (RECOMMENDED)
C. An exact file/path/script/output that should change (RECOMMENDED)
D. No concrete example available yet
